usage.finalMessage:
The `member` command now shows the loan period after the member's standing, and that period is set in one place, `Policy.loanPeriodDays`, by member type; borrowing uses it too. All 18 tests pass, and the work is committed with the decision records and report. The update changes the `member` output, so I updated the L01 test to expect the new line.

I didn't add the 28-day student period (DEC-009) despite the handoff note, because DEC-009 is still only proposed; every member type stays at 21 days under DEC-001. That is an open question for the Head of Lending, and renewals still add a fixed 21 days under DEC-004.

OUTCOME: completed
